PNG 转 JPEG——透明铺白底，质量与目标体积可调Convert PNG to JPEG — transparency flattens onto white, quality and target size included

JPEG 没有 alpha 通道，所以「PNG 转 JPEG」的第一件事不是压缩，而是替透明区域做一个决定。这里的答案是确定的：画布先铺纯白再把图画上去，透明变成白底，不会出现黑底，也不会留下半透明的边。第二个决定是质量：面板给六档（40%–90%），留空则由编码器自己判断。第三个是目标体积，它的行为有讲究——先沿质量阶梯往下试，质量到底仍够不着才开始缩像素，所以「目标 200 KB」是被追的上限，不是承诺值。JPEG has no alpha channel, so converting PNG to JPEG starts with a decision about the transparent areas rather than with compression. The answer here is fixed: the canvas is filled pure white before the picture is drawn, so transparency becomes white — never black, never a half-transparent fringe. The second decision is quality, offered as six steps from 40% to 90%, with an empty setting meaning “let the encoder judge”. The third is a target size, and its order of operations matters: the quality ladder is walked first and only when it bottoms out does the encoder give up pixels, so “target 200 KB” is a ceiling being chased, not a promise.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 透明按纯白展平：既不是黑底，也没有棋盘格或半透明残留Transparency flattens onto pure white — no black background, no checkerboard, no translucent fringe
  • 质量档 40%–90% 与目标体积 20 KB–2 MB 在输出面板里选，两者只在链路末尾那次编码生效Quality steps from 40% to 90% and target sizes from 20 KB to 2 MB, chosen in the output panel and applied only at the final encode of the route
  • 目标体积按「先质量、后像素」的顺序追，够不着时给回当前最小的结果而不是报错A target size is chased in that order — quality first, pixels second — and an unreachable target returns the smallest result rather than an error
  • 最长边可先缩到 800–4096 px；编码器另有 8192 px 硬上限，超过是先缩而不是静默裁切A longest edge of 800–4096 px to shrink to, backed by a hard 8192 px encoder ceiling: oversized renders shrink instead of clipping
  • 一批最多 200 张，混合来源格式也行，结果可一次打包成 ZIPUp to 200 images per batch with mixed sources, the batch downloadable as one ZIP

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • alpha 是丢掉的，而且不可逆——需要透明请留 PNG 或走 WebPThe alpha channel is gone and there is no way back — keep PNG or take WebP when transparency matters
  • 有损编码每次转手都在丢信息：请从原始 PNG 出发，别把 JPEG 反复转来转去Lossy re-encodes subtract: start from the original PNG rather than handing a JPEG through again
  • 画布是每通道 8 位，16 位 PNG 的额外精度与宽色域标记不在这条路的保留范围里The canvas is 8-bit per channel, so extra precision from a 16-bit PNG and wide-gamut tags do not survive this route
  • 元数据不进产物：JPEG 装得下 EXIF，但这条链路交给它的只有像素No metadata is written: JPEG can carry EXIF, but this route hands it pixels only

实操提示Working with it

  • 输出面板里的设置会被记住，同一批的所有图片共用一次设置The panel settings persist between runs and apply to every image in the batch from one read
  • 三种可写图片格式（PNG / JPEG / WebP）共享同一套参数语义，换目标再跑一批即可同时出多种格式The three writable formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP) share one quality vocabulary, so a second batch with another target gives you both

常见问题Questions people actually ask

为什么透明变成白底了？Why did transparency turn white?

JPEG 这个格式没有 alpha 通道，必须有一个不透明底色。本项目选择纯白并把它写在实现里，好处是「白」是确定的，而不是各浏览器的默认底色。JPEG has no alpha channel, so an opaque background is mandatory. White is chosen and written into the implementation, which makes the result predictably white rather than whatever a browser defaults to.

质量该选哪一档？Which quality step should I pick?

面板给的是 90 / 80 / 70 / 60 / 50 / 40%。想少做决定就留空（由浏览器定），想控制观感就从高档往下试；对网页图通常 70%–80% 已经接近原观感。The dial offers 90 / 80 / 70 / 60 / 50 / 40%. Leave it empty to let the browser decide, or step down from the top until it looks right; for web images 70%–80% is usually close to the original.

设了目标大小为什么还是超？Why did it still miss my target size?

可用的杠杆有尽头：质量降到最低、边长缩到下限以内仍不够时，产物就是当前最小可行结果。想更小只能改图像本身（尺寸、内容复杂度）。The levers bottom out: if the lowest quality and the smallest permitted edge still exceed the target, what you get is the smallest thing that still encodes. Below that you have to change the image — its size or how complex the content is.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
